role: V (validation). Fixed planar interface, 1-D, independent reference. NOT an emergence claim; NOT a Room; NOT an experiments/eNNN entry; NOT a P10 vessel result.

math_model.free_energy_reference: F_ref[c|phi] = sum_j dx * sum_i [ RT c_ij (ln(c_ij/c_ref) - 1) + chi_i phi_j c_ij ]
math_model.chemical_potential: mu_ij = RT ln(c_ij / c_ref) + chi_i phi_j
math_model.mobility: M = D(phi) / RT (shared by all species)
math_model.flux_main_B: J_{j+1/2} = - M_face * c_face * (mu_{j+1} - mu_j) / dx ; M_face = (M_j + M_{j+1})/2 ; c_face = (c_j + c_{j+1})/2
math_model.flux_control_A_fick: J_{j+1/2} = - D_face * (c_{j+1} - c_j) / dx ; D_face = (D_j + D_{j+1})/2  (literal F0 form, no chi)
math_model.phi_chem_potential_for_T1_only: mu_phi = a phi (phi^2-1) - div_h(kappa(m) grad phi) + sum_i chi_i c_i ; mu_m_interface = (kappa'(m)/2) |grad phi|^2
math_model.kappa_of_m: kappa0 * (1 - alpha * m), kappa0 = 1.0, alpha = 0.5 (T1 only; not used in transport runs)

geometry.phi_profile: phi(x) = tanh((x0 - x) / w), x0 = 0.5, w = 0.05 (main); w = 0.02 (sharp stress case T3s)
geometry.phi_sign: phi > 0 for x < x0 ('inside' = left half); phi < 0 for x > x0 ('outside' = right half)

time.rationale_t_eq: Holley-Stroock gives a spectral-gap lower bound gap >= pi^2 D exp(-osc), osc = 2|beta| (phi in [-1,1]). Worst cases used: beta=0.5 with D=0.25 -> gap >= 0.90, so exp(-40*0.90) = 2e-16 ; beta=1.5 with D=1 (sharp T3s) -> gap >= 0.49, so exp(-40*0.49) = 3e-9. The equilibrium criterion T3_boltzmann_cv_at_t_eq_max is checked at run time anyway, so the bound is a justification, not the test.

integrators.primary: scipy.integrate.solve_ivp, method=BDF, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-12, jac_sparsity = tridiagonal

scenarios.T1: finite-difference variation of F_ref and of the phi/m terms at a random positive state (N=32, seed 1)
scenarios.T2: Fick (A) vs mu-flux (B) with D(phi)=linear, beta=+0.5, N=128, same IC, no reaction, no-flux, to t_eq
scenarios.T3: equilibrium partition, D const, beta=+0.5, N in {64,128,256}; plus sharp stress (w=0.02, beta=1.5, N=256)
scenarios.T4: species A beta=+0.5 and species B beta=-0.5 sharing the same D(phi)=const, N=128, to t_eq
scenarios.T5: controls: beta_A=beta_B=+0.5 ; beta_A=beta_B=0 (uniform IC c=1 for the second)
scenarios.T6: D sweep const D in {0.25,1,4} and linear D(phi), beta=+0.5, N=128, to t_eq; relaxation time measured
scenarios.T7: conservation, positivity, finiteness, boundary-flux structure over all runs
scenarios.T8a: F_ref(t) monotonicity for B flux, N in {64,128,256}, beta=+0.5 and beta=-0.5, D const, to t=2
scenarios.T8b: energy identity dF/dt = -dissipation (B flux) integrated over [0,2], N=128
scenarios.T8c: EXPLORATORY ONLY (no verdict): F_ref(t) for Fick flux A with IC c0(x)=1+0.5cos(pi x), beta=+0.5
scenarios.T9: read-only comparison with existing V0: (a) its 3D sphere test suite; (b) planar slab in 3D arrays of shape (24,4,4) with phi(x) only, beta=0.5, D=1, dx=1 (index units)
scenarios.T10a: spatial convergence at t_check, N in {64,128,256} vs reference N=512, L1 error on cell averages
scenarios.T10b: time-tolerance convergence at t_check, N=128, rtol in {1e-6,1e-8,1e-10} vs reference rtol 1e-11
scenarios.T10c: RK4 time-step convergence at t_check, N=64, dt in {2e-5,1e-5} vs BDF reference rtol 1e-11

metric_definitions.discrete_equilibrium: c_j^disc = K exp(-beta phi_j), K from total mass M0 (exact zero-flux state of the B scheme)
metric_definitions.continuum_equilibrium: c(x) = M0 exp(-beta phi(x)) / int exp(-beta phi) dx, evaluated on a 16384-point midpoint quadrature
metric_definitions.partition_ratio_measured: mean_{x_j < x0} c_j / mean_{x_j > x0} c_j
metric_definitions.partition_ratio_predicted_discrete: mean_{x_j<x0} exp(-beta phi_j) / mean_{x_j>x0} exp(-beta phi_j)
metric_definitions.partition_ratio_predicted_continuum: (int_0^x0 e^{-beta phi} dx / x0) / (int_x0^L e^{-beta phi} dx / (L - x0))
metric_definitions.selectivity_S: partition_ratio(B) / partition_ratio(A)  (>1 means B is enriched inside relative to A)
metric_definitions.relaxation_time_T6: first t with max_j |c_j(t) - c_eq_j| / c_eq_j <= 1e-2
metric_definitions.F_ref: sum_j dx sum_i [ RT c (ln(c/c_ref) - 1) + chi phi c ]

verdict_rules.PASS: all pre-registered conditions of the test met
verdict_rules.FAIL: a pre-registered condition not met (including negative or non-finite concentration, or solver failure reported by the integrator)
verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: order/convergence in the band between the INCONCLUSIVE and PASS thresholds, or non-monotone, or evidence insufficient
verdict_rules.OUT_OF_SCOPE: not part of this validator (reaction, fuel, interface formation, mechanical flow, 3D Room)
verdict_rules.T2_meaning: PASS means the prediction 'Fick flux A produces no chi-driven partition' is confirmed. It is a negative finding about the F0-as-written flux, not a claim that P10 cannot select species.
verdict_rules.T8c_meaning: EXPLORATORY: reported as observed; contributes no verdict

failure_conditions: any negative or non-finite concentration at any saved time (no clipping allowed)
any mass residual above T7 tolerance
T10a order below 0.5 or error non-monotone with N
any PASS-condition change after the first run (would require a new run ID and a recorded amendment)
out_of_scope: chemical reactions f->m->w (not implemented; D-5 is unresolved)
interface formation, membrane self-organization, curvature (planar fixed interface only)
non-equilibrium permeability (not measured; only equilibrium partition and transient relaxation)
any 3D emergence claim, any Genesis Room, any experiments/eNNN
the B3 bridge and any vertical-level claim
